verdict.rationale: The Global Catalog MCP server lets agents search products across the entire Shopify ecosystem, with offers from multiple merchants clustered by UPID. Access only requires a self-published agent profile URL, and an Anonymous trust tier exists, so no private partnership is needed. Runtime probes confirmed a keyless handshake with the catalog endpoint and a successful CLI search plus cart creation using a self-generated local profile. A raw call without a hosted profile returned an error, which matches the documented identity requirement. Missing for 10: hands-on proof of a successful cross-merchant Global Catalog search result (probes confirmed only the handshake and a search plus cart on a single Shopify-run store), and confirmation of Anonymous-tier rate limits adequate for real use.
